title: Polls
description: Ask questions, edit them and close them.
newDescription: A poll is published as soon as it is created.

question.label: Question
question.placeholder: What do you want to ask?

options.label: Answers
options.hint: {min} to {max} answers, each up to {length} characters.
options.frozen: Someone has voted, so the answers can no longer change.

closesAt.label: Closes on
closesAt.hint: Voting ends at the end of this day. Empty: no end.

anonymous.label: Anonymous voting
anonymous.hint: Nobody sees who voted for what.

departments.label: Restrict to departments
departments.hint: Only members of the chosen departments see it and vote; editors and admins always see it. None chosen: everyone (guests only if it is visible to them).

guestAccess.hint: Polls are hidden from guests by default. Guests vote only on a poll that is visible to them.
